caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, ornately-carved keyboard instrument with a wooden body and curved, decorative legs. The main body of the instrument is medium brown, resembling polished wood, with intricate carved details along the top music stand and the legs. The legs are shaped with symmetrical cut-outs and decorative flourishes. There are two elongated white decorative elements on each side of the body above the legs. The keyboard features alternating black and white keys extending the length of the instrument. Two thin blue rods extend vertically from beneath the main body downward to two small blue pedals positioned just above floor level. The shadow of the instrument is rendered in a faint, pale brown tone on the ground. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery included.
title: Gem Roller Organ
